name: Harley-Davidson Evolution Softail
engine: 1340 cc air-cooled Evolution V-twin, one carb, belt drive (most)
intro: The Evo Softail. Reliable, but base gasket and rocker box leaks are almost a given.

add.title: Check the base and rocker box gaskets
add.instructions: Clean the engine and look for oil at the cylinder base, especially near the oil return, and at the rocker boxes. Plan a top-end reseal if they weep.
add.reason: Base gasket leaks are the best-known Evo fault and get worse as the gasket bakes.
add.src: Fix My Hog Evo top-end notes

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Base and rocker gaskets
known.what: Most Evos that haven't been rebuilt leak at the base and rocker box gaskets.
